text: This report provides an annual update on the City's loan and loan guarantee portfolios, along with the details associated with each of the credit arrangements. Under existing policies, as at December 31, 2021, the City has guaranteed operating lines of credit amounting to approximately $6 million, and almost $59 million in capital loans. In addition, the City has an outstanding amount of $48 million in direct loans to City agencies and corporations which contribute to the financing of projects that create or enhance municipal capital facilities. None of these loans were in default during this reporting period. One loan of approximately $12 million to the Bloor Street Transformation Project was fully repaid during this period.
